licoes.objectivo: Confirmar informação com question tags e usar a entoação que confirma ou que pergunta.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: You're from Lubango, [aren't you]?

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: You arrived yesterday, [didn't you]?

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: You don't take sugar, [do you]?

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I'm late, [aren't I]?

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Let's get a coffee, [shall we]?

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the correct sentence.

opcoes.texto: It's cold this morning, isn't it?
It's cold this morning, aren't it?

exercicios.enunciado: You're sure, and you only want the other person to agree. On the tag, your voice goes…
"You're from Luanda, aren't you?" But you're from Lubango. What do you say?

opcoes.texto: No, I'm not. Actually, I'm from Lubango.
Yes, I'm not. I'm from Lubango.
No, I am. I'm from Lubango.

exercicios.frase: I'm Sipho, from the help desk. You're Nuno, aren't you? We spoke on the phone in March, didn't we?
exercicios.enunciado: When did Sipho and Nuno speak on the phone?

exercicios.frase: It's cold this morning, isn't it?
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita, com a voz a descer na tag.
Think of a colleague. Check three things about him or her with question tags.
exercicios.frase: n't
exercicios.resposta: You live in Talatona, don't you? You started in January, didn't you? You can drive, can't you?
exercicios.contexto: Três tags: present simple, past simple e can.

exercicios.enunciado: You meet a new colleague at a training course. Check two things, then suggest a coffee.
exercicios.frase: shall we
exercicios.resposta: You're in the IT team, aren't you? You arrived on Monday, didn't you? Let's get a coffee, shall we?
exercicios.contexto: Duas tags e uma sugestão com shall we.

licoes.titulo: Could you tell me where room four is?
licoes.objectivo: Fazer perguntas educadas com perguntas indirectas, com a ordem de afirmação e com if / whether.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Do you know [if] there's a printer on this floor?

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Do you know what time the bus [leaves]?

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the correct question.

opcoes.texto: Could you tell me where the meeting room is?
Could you tell me where is the meeting room?
Could you tell me where does the meeting room is?

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the correct question.

opcoes.texto: Do you know when the shop opens?
Do you know when does the shop open?
Do you know when opens the shop?

exercicios.enunciado: "Is the canteen open?" Make it polite.

opcoes.texto: Do you know if the canteen is open?
Do you know is the canteen open?
Do you know if is the canteen open?

exercicios.enunciado: "Where can I buy a SIM card?" Make it polite.

opcoes.texto: Do you know where I can buy a SIM card?
Do you know where can I buy a SIM card?
Do you know where do I can buy a SIM card?

exercicios.enunciado: Pode dizer-me onde fica a sala quatro?
exercicios.resposta: Could you tell me where room four is?

exercicios.enunciado: Sabe a que horas sai o autocarro?
exercicios.resposta: Do you know what time the bus leaves?

exercicios.frase: This is Zanele, from reception. The bus to the data centre leaves at ten, from the main entrance.
exercicios.enunciado: What time does the bus leave?

exercicios.frase: Could you tell me where room four is?
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita: "Could you" ligado e a voz a subir um pouco no fim.
You're at a hotel reception. Ask three polite questions.
exercicios.frase: Could you tell me
exercicios.resposta: Could you tell me what time breakfast starts? Do you know if the Wi-Fi is free? And could you tell me where I can get a taxi?
exercicios.contexto: Perguntas indirectas, com a ordem de afirmação.

exercicios.enunciado: You call a new supplier. Ask two polite questions about prices and delivery.
exercicios.frase: Do you know
exercicios.resposta: Good morning. Could you tell me how much the installation costs? And do you know if you deliver to Benguela?

licoes.objectivo: Fazer perguntas de sujeito e de objecto e manter a conversa com perguntas de seguimento.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Who [invited] you to the training? — Lerato did.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Who [did you meet] at lunch? — I met Kofi.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: What [happened] next?

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: What [did you do] after the training?

exercicios.enunciado: "Lerato invited Nuno." Ask about Lerato.
"Nuno called Thandi." Ask about Thandi.
Kofi: "I worked for a bank for five years." Choose the best follow-up question.
Kofi: "The control centre is my second home." You don't understand. You say:

exercicios.frase: I'm Kofi, from Accra. I worked for a bank for five years. Then one day a friend offered me a job at a solar company.
exercicios.enunciado: Who offered Kofi a job?

exercicios.frase: Who invited you? Who did you meet?
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita, com o acento em "who" e no verbo.
How did you start in your job or your studies? Give some extra information.
exercicios.frase: started
exercicios.resposta: I started at the bank in 2019. Actually, I studied engineering, but I couldn't find a job. Then a friend told me about a job in the IT department, and I said yes.
exercicios.contexto: Uma história curta no past simple, com pormenores.

exercicios.enunciado: A colleague says: "I changed jobs last year." Ask three follow-up questions.
exercicios.frase: Why
exercicios.resposta: Really? Why did you change? What do you do now? And what's your new job like?

licoes.objectivo: Abrir, manter e fechar uma conversa num evento; So do I / Neither do I; compromise e comprehensive.

exercicios.enunciado: Ligue cada palavra à tradução.
"What brings you here?" means…

opcoes.texto: Why are you at this event?

exercicios.enunciado: Which is a good way to close a conversation?

opcoes.texto: Well, it was great talking to you. Let's keep in touch.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I'll [follow] up by email next week.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Let's keep in [touch].

exercicios.enunciado: "I love coffee." You love coffee too. You say:
"I don't like the cold." You don't like it either. You say:
"Tenho um compromisso às três." Em inglês:

opcoes.texto: I have an appointment at three.
I have a compromise at three.
I have a compromising at three.

exercicios.explicacao: compromise = cedência, um acordo em que os dois lados cedem.

exercicios.enunciado: "O meu chefe é muito compreensivo." Em inglês:

exercicios.frase: So do I. Neither do I. So did I.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita, com o acento em "I".
Open a conversation with a stranger at a conference, and ask two questions.
exercicios.frase: What brings you here
exercicios.resposta: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Ana, from Benguela. What brings you here? And what line of work are you in?

exercicios.enunciado: Close the conversation, with a plan to keep in touch.
exercicios.frase: keep in touch
exercicios.resposta: Well, it was great talking to you. Let's keep in touch — here's my card. I'll send you an email next week.

licoes.titulo: Real English: At the welcome event
licoes.objectivo: Identificar quem é cada pessoa, de onde vem, o que faz e como a conversa continua.

exercicios.frase: I'm Mei. I'm a software developer, and I work for a mobile payments company in Lusaka.
exercicios.enunciado: Where does Mei work?

exercicios.frase: I'm Mei. I'm from Chengdu, in China. I moved to Zambia four years ago.
exercicios.enunciado: When did Mei move to Zambia?

exercicios.frase: I'm Carlos Mondlane, from Maputo, in Mozambique. So Nuno and I can speak Portuguese!
exercicios.enunciado: Why can Carlos speak Portuguese with Nuno?

exercicios.frase: This is Carlos. We use a mobile payment system at the port, and it's always slow.
exercicios.enunciado: What's the problem at Carlos's port?

exercicios.frase: I'm Kofi. A group of us are going to a restaurant in Melville on Thursday night, around nine.
exercicios.enunciado: When is the dinner?

exercicios.frase: This is Lerato. Tonight there are people from five countries in this room. So please, go and meet someone new.
exercicios.enunciado: What does Lerato ask people to do?
Kofi asks: "Do you want to come?" Which answer is correct?
exercicios.explicacao: So do I responde a uma afirmação, não a uma pergunta.

exercicios.enunciado: How does Nuno bring Kofi into the group?

opcoes.texto: He introduces Mei and Carlos to him.

exercicios.frase: Come and join us. This is Mei, from Lusaka.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita em voz alta.

exercicios.frase: But you're not from Zambia, are you?
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita, com a voz a subir na tag.
Introduce a colleague to two people at an event: name, city and job.
exercicios.frase: This is
exercicios.resposta: Come and join us! This is Rosa, from Huambo — she's an accountant. And this is David, from Lagos. He works in logistics.

exercicios.enunciado: At events, do you prefer to meet new people or to talk to your colleagues? Why?
exercicios.frase: prefer
exercicios.resposta: I prefer to meet new people, because I always learn something. But at the beginning I talk to my colleagues — it's easier.

licoes.objectivo: Apresentar-se em 30 segundos, manter e fechar a conversa, e explicar em inglês um folheto em português.

exercicios.enunciado: Which is the best 30-second introduction?

opcoes.texto: I'm Nuno Kapinga. I'm a technician at Kalandula Tech. We install networks and give technical support. At the moment I'm in a joint team in Johannesburg. And you?
I'm Nuno, and I was born in Lubango, and I studied there, and then I moved to Luanda, and I have a sister, and…

exercicios.enunciado: You want to change the topic. You say:
Hannah: "Our network goes down every time there's a sandstorm." Choose the best follow-up.
Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: You're only here for the training, [aren't you]?

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Do you know [if] the cables are underground?

exercicios.enunciado: The leaflet says: "Apoio técnico 24 horas por dia." Nuno says:

opcoes.texto: We give technical support twenty-four hours a day.
We support techniques twenty-four hours per day.

exercicios.enunciado: In the mediation, Nuno…

opcoes.texto: gives the main points in English

exercicios.frase: I'm Hannah Becker. I'm a project engineer at Morro Azul Energia. We have a solar plant in Namibe.
exercicios.enunciado: Where is Hannah's solar plant?

exercicios.frase: Hannah, I fly back to Luanda on Saturday, and I'll send you an email on Monday the nineteenth.
exercicios.enunciado: When will the speaker send Hannah an email?

exercicios.frase: Well, it was great talking to you. Let's keep in touch.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita, com voz simpática.
Introduce yourself and your company in thirty seconds. End with a question.
exercicios.frase: And you
exercicios.resposta: I'm Rosa Silva. I'm an accountant at a construction company in Benguela. We build schools and hospitals. At the moment, I'm working on the budget for a new hospital. And you?
exercicios.contexto: Nome, empresa, o que faz a empresa, o agora e uma pergunta.

exercicios.enunciado: Explain this leaflet in English: "Centro Médico Mulemba — consultas de segunda a sábado, das 8h às 20h. Médicos de família e análises clínicas. Marcações por telefone."
exercicios.frase: It says
exercicios.resposta: It says it's a clinic. It's open from Monday to Saturday, from eight a.m. to eight p.m. There are family doctors, and you can do blood tests. You can book by phone.
exercicios.contexto: Mediação: só os pontos principais, com It says…

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.

Choose the correct question.

opcoes.texto: Do you know if the meeting is at ten?
Do you know is the meeting at ten?
Do you know if is the meeting at ten?

exercicios.enunciado: Reciclagem (A2, unidade 6). Choose the correct sentence.

opcoes.texto: I have gone there last year.

If it will rain, we'll stay inside.

opcoes.texto: I enjoy meeting new people, and she speaks English well.
I enjoy to meet new people, and she speaks well English.
I enjoy meet new people, and she speaks English good.

exercicios.enunciado: Vamos manter o contacto.

exercicios.frase: I'm Neo, from Gaborone. We're opening an office in Luanda next year, probably near the port.
exercicios.enunciado: Where is Neo's company opening an office?
You meet someone at a conference. Check one thing with a tag, ask one indirect question, and close the conversation.
exercicios.frase: keep in touch
exercicios.resposta: You're from Kalandula Tech, aren't you? Could you tell me what your company does in Benguela? … Well, it was great talking to you. Let's keep in touch.

exercicios.enunciado: Tell me about the last time you met someone new at work. Who was it, and what did you talk about?
exercicios.frase: met
exercicios.resposta: Last month I met a new client from Lisbon at a meeting. We talked about the project, and then about football. We exchanged contacts, and now we email every week.
exercicios.contexto: Uma história curta no past simple.
